From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Subject: Sunset messaging strike team — invite & immediate asks

Team —

We're kicking up a short-lived "sunset messaging" strike team to get ahead of the next model deprecation window and lock down comms, exemption gating, and rollback/runbook items. Goal: produce a customer-facing messaging set and exemption checklist we can ship to Sales/CS and start 1:1 outreach by Dec 6.

Agenda for the first sync (30m):
- Confirm customer segmentation and notice windows (90/180 days)
- Finalize comm templates and channel matrix (email, in-console banner, Help Center)
- Define exemption criteria + owner for each gate
- Rollback/fallback plan & Dedicated customer coordination

Immediate asks (please before EOD PST) —
1) Marissa: list 10 high-risk customers who need extended notice or escalation (include account owner).
2) Ben: outline rollback/fallback options for hosted + Dedicated and any constraints.
3) Naomi & Mina: flag any compliance/legal copy constraints and audit evidence we must collect in comms.
4) Priyom: volunteer to be the ops lead for cutover/rollback runbook.

I've attached initial templates and an exemption gating checklist (WIP). Please reply with confirmations and any conflicts for a 30m slot between 10:00–12:00 PST today; if you can't make it, indicate proxy.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sunset-messaging-templates-v0.9.docx, exemption-gating-checklist.xlsx, customer-segmentation-sample.csv

Adding security & compliance context:
- Any customer communication that references data handling, retention, or "no SLA impact" needs legal review. Mina, can you coordinate with Legal?
- Audit evidence: for gated exemptions we should capture the decision record (who approved, criteria matched, timestamp) and store it in a central folder. We should also ensure the console banner changes and email sends are logged with message IDs and delivery receipts for at least 1 year.
- For Dedicated / on-prem customers, some of the proposed in-console banners won't apply; we need an ops checklist for manual outreach and an evidence template.
